test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following bar chart shows the marks obtained (out of 100) by a student in 7 different subjects in an examination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a038de59171dfe32afbd919bbdccb54e865a1e1f463cd3b6fcd7361db48fa3ba.png] 

The total marks obtained by the student in S1 and S6 taken together is approximately what percentage of the marks obtained by the student in S4?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total marks obtained by the student in S1 and S6 = 96 + 59

⇒ 155

The marks obtained by the student in S4 = 71

So, required % = (155/71) × 100

218.31%

**∴ The required answer is 218.31%.**
